product_metadata.title: Owlgift Metal Butterfly Shaped Napkin Holder, Tabletop Paper Towel Dispenser, w/Freestanding Tissue Stand, Storage (Turquoise)
features: Butterfly design tabletop napkin holder in turquoise metal.
Measures just under 7 inches in width and height to hold standard-size napkins.
Classic finish complements any home decor, suitable for indoor and outdoor use with it's heavy weight steel construction.
The charming silhouette design make this napkin holder ideal for home and commercial use: cafes, coffee shops, office break rooms.
Approximate Dimensions (in inches): 5 W X 5.25 H X 2 D.
